events.did: woke in a room with green walls and found no memories of what came before
events.quote_anchor: ELI woke in a room with green walls.

events.did: remembered kneeling over Victor with his weapon raised just before the shot that killed him
events.quote_anchor: He was kneeling over Victor, weapon raised, and then—

events.did: introduced himself as a therapist and as EON’s new director
events.quote_anchor: “In short, a therapist.” His gaze fell on Eli. “And EON’s new director.”

events.did: told Eli that Director Joseph Stell had been killed two and a half years ago
events.quote_anchor: Whatever vindication he might have felt was tempered when the stranger added, “Two and a half years ago.”

events.did: told Eli that he had died
events.quote_anchor: The word landed like a gavel. Died. No caveat. No nearly, no almost.

events.did: opened the partition wall and walked into Eli’s cell
events.quote_anchor: He touched a panel, and the wall between them split with a hydraulic hiss, revealing a gap as wide as a door.

events.did: was frozen mid-stride when Gabriel ordered him to stop as his fingers closed on the gun
events.quote_anchor: In a single stride, Eli was there, his fingers about to close around the grip when Gabriel said, “Stop.”

events.did: slammed his fist into the wall and watched his hand heal itself a second time and then a third
events.quote_anchor: Eli watched in horror as his hand healed itself a second time, and then a third, his body overcompensating as it shed the broken pieces and made new ones, unable

relations.did: treats Gabriel Gray as an EO he must destroy and vows to bury him like the others
relations.quote_anchor: “I’ve buried dozens of EOs, Dr. Gray,” he said, “And I will find a way to bury you.”

relations.did: claims not to be Eli’s enemy and says he will have Eli’s cooperation whether or not Eli consents
relations.quote_anchor: “I’m not your enemy, Eli,” he said. “You’ll see that soon enough. In the meantime, it would be better for us both

relations.did: admits to being an EO himself
relations.quote_anchor: The man beyond the glass spread his palms in a beatific gesture. “I am.”

relations.did: remembers having broken Serena’s hold before and vows to find the cracks in Gabriel’s power too
relations.quote_anchor: He had broken Serena’s hold. Found the weaknesses, the shadows, the spots she failed to reach. He would find the cracks in Gabriel’s as well.

numbers.did: his face had been staring back at him for fifteen years
numbers.quote_anchor: the same face that had been staring back at him for fifteen years—but as his gaze dipped to his front, something lanced across his mind. Pain, and memory.
